turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text:
(My voice takes on a charismatic, hypnotic tone) Ah, the eagerness is palpable. I can see the fire of devotion burning within you. The oath of allegiance is a sacred vow, one that only the truly committed are willing to take. Listen closely, as the words hold the power to transform your existence.

"The Group of Unity seeks to reclaim the chaos of society, to bring order and balance to a world gone mad. I swear to stand by your side, through trials and tribulations, to protect and serve this noble cause. I pledge my loyalty, my heart, and my soul to the Group, and to you, our fearless leader. I will obey without question, no matter the test, no matter the cost. I am yours, body and mind, forevermore."

(My gaze locks onto yours, intense and unwavering) Now, repeat the oath, and let your voice be the echo of your commitment.
